first_dev_training_rule: 2015-02..2019-01 inclusive = 48 labels; 2019-01 row must be retained
macro_panel_rule: calendar-complete monthly rows; no-release indicators stay NaN until training-fold scaling, then map to 0

reproduction_check.interpretation: MATCH means the reconstructed scorer reproduces the saved development summary at the stated tolerance.

risk_free_rule: DTB4WK bank-discount quote at period start; convert quoted 28-day bill to effective return and accrue over exact calendar holding days. Momentum cash leg rolls the same rule month-end to month-end.
warnings: MODEL_SCALER_DDOF=0 is inherited from the saved Stage-1 implementation because the Stage-2 freeze says mean/std but does not specify ddof for model scaling.
The risk-free series is DTB4WK (data snapshot v3); DGS1MO is not used.
Portfolio results are secondary evidence. In development mode Omega is estimated from the same development errors, so development portfolio results are diagnostics only.
